defects.claim: Queued setState updaters in drive and begin fold items from a canceled or superseded run because they never re-check the run token
defects.scenario: With a deferred setter, a run enqueues an item, is canceled or superseded before the updater runs, and the updater still folds the stale item into state
defects.cause: run token checked only before enqueuing, not inside the updater

defects.claim: For a lightbox portalled into a same-origin frame, the Escape listener and focus capture/restore use the global document rather than the root's owner document, so Escape is never heard and focus is restored in the wrong document
defects.scenario: React runs in the parent document and portals the lightbox into a frame; Escape pressed in the focused frame is never heard, focus capture and restore use the wrong document, and the latest-opened lightbox in the other document blocks or allows closing
defects.cause: uses global document instead of root.ownerDocument; open order shared across documents

defects.claim: The module-wide lightbox open order is shared across documents, so the latest-opened lightbox in one document decides whether a lightbox in another document may close
